diagram_title: patentmcp R17 minimum operational toolset conformance

activities.title: Portable result retrieval (resources/read)
activities.description: Expose every produced token-store binary through protocol-native MCP resources/list + resources/read, so a bare client retrieves it without the host-private /files blob or WebDAV extension.

activities.title: Structured capability summary
activities.description: patentmcp_init returns prose doctrine PLUS a compact machine-readable capability summary, distinguishing container/service endpoints from host-visible endpoints.

activities.title: Typed asset preflight + content assertions
activities.description: Delivery-oriented operations (cache_export) reject unresolved/empty/out-of-namespace assets before landing and emit machine-checkable content assertions; an empty artifact is never reported delivery-ready.
